newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Williams-Sonoma initial rating hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Williams-Sonoma initial rating hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Williams-Sonoma Inc with a rating of hold.

-- Dain analyst Dean Ramos said he is impressed with the company's logistical turnaround and franchise position at the upper end of the home furnishings segment. The company is also expected to add 26 stores in 1997.

-- Ramos said the company's Pottery Barn unit and potential improvement in catalog profits will most likely frive earnings growth in the next year. Dain's initial estimate for fiscal 1997 earnings is $1 per share.
-- Williams-Sonoma owns 240 housewares and furniture stores in addition to a mail-order catalog business.
-- Its stock was up 1/4 Friday afternoon at 30-7/8.
